description: Create a meeting. Required: title, start_at (ISO), end_at (ISO). Optional: lead_id, contact_id, campaign_id, status (pending|confirmed|cancelled), notes (INTERN — wird dem Gast NIE gezeigt), invitation_text (was der eingeladene Gast in der Einladung liest; leer = neutraler Text aus Titel und Zugangsweg), customer_name, customer_email, video_provider ('google_meet'|'teams' — attaches a video link synchronously via the tenant's connected integration; 'delegaize' — a built-in video room on the DelegAIze platform, no external integration needed, the guest joins the returned video_link without an account; omit for no video link), timezone. Times without a UTC offset are read as wall-clock time in the caller's timezone (pass timezone, an IANA name, to override) — so '14:00' means 14:00 where the user is, not 14:00 UTC. If video_provider is set but that integration isn't connected (Integrations page), the meeting is still created — check the response's video_link_error. With video_provider 'teams' or 'google_meet' the meeting is written as an event INTO THE HOST'S OWN CALENDAR (Outlook/Google) with the video link and the guest invited, provided the host has a connected writable calendar; otherwise only a link is created and calendar_event=false with calendar_reason says why. Use this — not create_calendar_event — for a Teams/Meet appointment. TEAMS WITHOUT MICROSOFT 365: if no Microsoft calendar/Teams integration works (also on a Graph error), the link is created through the Teams web bridge on the host's computer (personal Teams works too); then video_link_source is 'bridge' and Teams invites ONLY the addresses in 'attendees' — customer_email alone triggers no Teams invitation. Returns { meeting_id, video_link?, video_link_source?, video_link_error?, calendar_event?, calendar?, calendar_reason?, invited? }.

attendees.description: Teams via bridge only: e-mail addresses Teams should INVITE. Omit = nobody is invited by Teams.

customer_email.description: E-Mail-Adresse des Gastes; loest bei Teams ueber die Bridge allein keine Einladung aus

invitation_text.description: What the invited guest reads in the invitation. Empty = neutral text from title and access link.

notes.description: INTERNAL preparation. Never shown to the guest, never written into the calendar event.

status.description: Status des Termins: pending, confirmed oder cancelled

teams_account.description: Teams via bridge only: which Teams account on the host's computer (e.g. 'arbeit'). Default: its default account.

timezone.description: IANA zone the given times are meant in; defaults to the caller's.

video_provider.description: 'google_meet', 'teams' or 'delegaize' — attach a video conferencing link on creation. 'delegaize' is the built-in room (no integration needed, guest joins by link).

name: create_meeting
